en.title: Common and proper nouns
en.summary: A common noun names a class of things; a proper noun names one particular person, place or thing.

paragraphs: A common noun names a whole class of things, such as city, river or teacher. A proper noun names one particular person, place or thing, such as Edinburgh, the Thames or Ms Clark. In English a proper noun always begins with a capital letter.

English capitalises proper nouns, including the days, the months, languages, nationalities and holidays. Most proper nouns take no article, but some take the. These include rivers, seas, mountain ranges, groups of islands and countries with a plural or a common-noun name.

blocks.html:
KindExample
always capitalisedMonday, April, English, Spanish
no articleLondon, Mary, Italy
with the (rivers, seas)the Thames, the Atlantic
with the (ranges, islands)the Alps, the Canary Islands
with the (country names)the United States, the Netherlands

paragraphs: A common noun can become part of a name and then takes a capital letter: the River Thames, Lake Victoria, Queen Elizabeth. When the same word is used in general, it stays lowercase: a queen, a lake.
The seasons and school subjects are common nouns in English and use lowercase: summer, history, mathematics. Languages are different: English, French and Latin always take a capital letter.

items: Wrong: **I speak english.** Right: **I speak English.**
Wrong: **We met on monday in april.** Right: **We met on Monday in April.**
Wrong: **We sailed on Thames.** Right: **We sailed on the Thames.**

ro.title: Substantive comune și proprii
ro.summary: Substantivul comun denumește ființe sau lucruri de același fel, iar substantivul propriu denumește o ființă sau un loc anume.

paragraphs: Substantivul este cuvântul care denumește ființe, lucruri sau locuri. Substantivele comune denumesc obiecte de același fel. Substantivele proprii denumesc o anumită persoană, un animal sau un loc anume. Substantivele proprii încep mereu cu literă mare.

Substantivele comune se scriu cu literă mică. Substantivele proprii încep întotdeauna cu majusculă. În limba română, zilele săptămânii și lunile anului sunt substantive comune, de aceea se scriu tot cu literă mică.
